messages:
sam-sales: Customer asked for our latest pen-test PDF, vulnerability scan outputs, and a CSV mapping to SIG/CAIQ controls for their vendor intake tool. Can we assemble and confirm timelines?

sam-sales: Uploaded draft artifacts: <https://files.redwood.com/share/pen-test-2026-q1-redacted.pdf|pen-test-2026-q1-redacted.pdf> and <https://files.redwood.com/share/vulnscan-2026-03-31.json.gz|vulnscan-2026-03-31.json.gz> :paperclip:

secops-bot: Upload recorded. Share link set to procurement-sme@acme.com (view only). Audit id: u-2026-912.

mira-sec: I validated the redaction (no customer PII). Quick scan summary: 4 findings total: 2 medium (one requires vendor patch, one is config), 2 low (dependency updates/cleanup).

lee-runtime: Which finding needs vendor patch?

mira-sec: FIND-2026-401 (medium) = upstream crypto lib; vendor patch required. FIND-2026-408 (medium) = gateway ciphers/headers, we can remediate. Low ones are deps removed and false positive leak.

ash-infra: Owners: gateway config -> ash-infra (ticket INF-4401), runtime patch -> lee-runtime (coordinating vendor). I'll queue the nginx change for 2026-04-09.

lee-runtime: Vendor says patch ETA 2026-04-15. I'll try to get an earlier backport; fallback is WAF rule until patch lands.

procurement-sme: We need: per-find owner, remediation SLA, re-scan date, and a signed attestation after re-scan. Our vendor team requires a CSV with columns: find_id,cve,control_id,control_family,remediation_status.

mira-sec: Proposed timeline:
- 2026-04-09: gateway config rollout to prod (owner: ash-infra)
- 2026-04-15: upstream patch expected; if delayed, document compensating controls
- 2026-04-16: canary smoke + 24h monitoring
- 2026-04-18: internal re-scan (job rs-2026-672)
- 2026-04-19: package evidence + signed attestation PDF + CSV mapping -> deliver to customer

sam-sales: I'll be the procurement contact and will send the bundle once we have the re-scan.

mira-sec: CSV example row I'll produce: FIND-2026-401,CVE-2026-2201,CC-6.6,Configuration Management,in_progress

lee-runtime: Verification commands we'll run after rollout:
```
./infra/tools/vuln_check --target runtime-service --ids FIND-2026-401,FIND-2026-408 --output rescan-2026-04-18.json
```

secops-bot: Re-scan job rs-2026-672 scheduled for 2026-04-18 02:15 UTC. Results will be archived at /sec/runs/rs-2026-672.

procurement-sme: Compensating controls accepted temporarily; need evidence (WAF rule config + monitoring alerts) if vendor delays. Signed attestation required on letterhead.

mira-sec: We'll include: sanitized pen-test PDF, original scanner JSON, vulnerability tracker export mapping internal IDs->CVEs, CAIQ/SIG CSV mapping, ticket links, WAF rule docs if used, and signed attestation after re-scan.

sam-sales: Action items: ash deploys config 4/9, lee confirms patch or compensating controls by 4/15, mira prepares CSV + attestation template, secops-bot runs re-scan. I'll update customer and attach final bundle. :white_check_mark:
